rationale.overall: A is closer to REF’s soft gel-over-plaster read, with stronger rim scatter and warmer cast/bounce relationships without B’s hard edge seam.
rationale.material: A’s orange rim wash is softer and more translucent with broader highlight falloff, while B keeps a sharper pinpoint specular and cooler, less SSS-driven shadow tint.
rationale.silhouette: Lid and tray outlines are nearly identical, but B’s bright white sliver along the gel’s lower-left edge breaks a contour that stays continuous on A and REF.
rationale.smallsize: At 128/32/16 both keep the orange cast over the cream mould readable with similar contrast, and neither clearly outlasts the other once pixelated.
